comments.author: WriterFreelance
comments.body:
Yo I got a solution. Have chat gpt make you a reference image of a tree without leafs. Then render a mesh from the image(multishot works best) transfer that tree to blender and have codex or your agent that works best with blender. And have it put on texture and leaves.
They are a little less good than professional trees but the tec is improving.
We need a dedicated harness for unity and blender and other game dev tools but its getting better.

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
Tree looks great.  You should be looking at the branches and trunk, not the leaves. If you want leaves to look good you use textured or masked quads for leaves. 

If your leaf planes in this were changed from flat color squares to quads  of leaf-shaped masks  (colored) or actual leaf textures these would look quite good actually.
